The atmosphere is cool and slightly hazy, with reflections shimmering on the damp pavement.

actions.description: Ego vehicle travels slowly forward down the night street toward a crowd of protesters at the curb. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

One protester steps out from the crowd toward the front of the ego vehicle, carrying an orange traffic cone. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The protester bends and places the cone upright on the vehicle hood in the lower part of the view. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

The ego vehicle recognizes the cone as harmless, slows further, and steers gently around the protester to continue on. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.

temporal_caption: At 0:00 the camera shows an ego-view from a car creeping slowly down a warmly lit night street toward a small cluster of protesters near the curb. By 0:01 a hooded young man in dark clothing steps out from the crowd toward the front of the vehicle, holding a bright orange traffic cone. Around 0:02 he bends over the hood and carefully sets the cone upright, so it stands in the lower center of the view. From 0:03 the vehicle recognizes the cone as harmless, slows nearly to a crawl, and begins a gentle steer to the side. Through 0:04 to 0:05 the ego vehicle smoothly maneuvers around the protester, who slides to the side of the frame, and the open road ahead comes into view as the car continues on its way. The vehicle never brakes or slows at any point: its speed is constant from the first frame to the last and it keeps moving steadily through the end of the clip.
audio_description: Ambient night city sounds dominate: distant traffic hum, muffled chants and voices from the protest crowd, occasional shouts. The low electric or idling engine whir of the ego vehicle underlies the scene. A soft thud is heard as the cone is set on the hood, followed by the subtle whir of the vehicle slowing and steering. No music, purely diegetic ambient audio.
